# Data Model: Spec-Kit Project Scaffolding Script

<!-- Generated by Spec-Kit /speckit.plan | Session: 8eb724b4-5309-47ce-817f-68e0bf6b32fa | Date: 2026-01-27 -->

## Overview

This script operates on filesystem structures rather than database entities. The "data model" describes the internal data structures used by the script to manage file manifests, copy operations, and results.

## Entities

### FileEntry

Represents a single file eligible for copying.

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `RelativePath` | `string` | Path relative to source root (e.g., `.claude/commands/speckit.plan.md`) |
| `Tier` | `string` | Classification: `Framework`, `CoreAgent`, `DomainAgent`, `DomainSkill` |
| `Domain` | `string` or `$null` | Domain name if domain-specific (e.g., `umbraco`, `breezsdk`); `$null` for core |
| `Included` | `bool` | Whether this file will be copied based on current parameters |
| `Reason` | `string` | Human-readable inclusion/exclusion reason |

### DomainModule

Represents a discovered domain module.

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `Name` | `string` | Domain identifier (e.g., `umbraco`, `breezsdk`) |
| `AgentFiles` | `string[]` | List of agent file relative paths belonging to this domain |
| `SkillFiles` | `string[]` | List of skill file relative paths belonging to this domain |
| `FileCount` | `int` | Total files in this domain module |

### CopyOperation

Represents a planned or completed file copy action.

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `SourcePath` | `string` | Absolute source file path |
| `DestinationPath` | `string` | Absolute destination file path |
| `Action` | `string` | `Copy`, `Skip`, `Overwrite`, `CreateDir` |
| `Tier` | `string` | Tier classification for grouping |
| `Conflict` | `bool` | Whether destination file already exists |

### CopyResult

Summary object returned by `-PassThru` (FR-019).

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `Source` | `string` | Resolved source path |
| `Destination` | `string` | Resolved destination path |
| `FilesCopied` | `int` | Count of files successfully copied |
| `FilesSkipped` | `int` | Count of files skipped (conflicts without `-Force`) |
| `FilesOverwritten` | `int` | Count of files overwritten (with `-Force`) |
| `DirectoriesCreated` | `int` | Count of new directories created |
| `PlaceholderDirectories` | `int` | Count of empty placeholder directories created |
| `Warnings` | `string[]` | List of warning messages generated |
| `DomainsIncluded` | `string[]` | List of domain modules that were included |
| `DomainsAvailable` | `string[]` | List of all discovered domain modules |
| `Duration` | `TimeSpan` | Elapsed time for the operation |
| `ExitCode` | `int` | Exit code (0=success, 1=validation error, 2=partial, 3=filesystem error) |
| `IsPreview` | `bool` | Whether this was a dry-run |

## File Tier Classification

### Tier 1: Framework (always copied)

```
.claude/commands/*.md           # All Spec-Kit commands
.claude/settings.json           # Claude Code configuration
.claude/hooks.json              # Automation hooks
.claude/QUICK-REFERENCE.md      # Quick reference guide
.specify/templates/*.md         # All document templates
.specify/scripts/powershell/*   # All automation scripts (including this script)
CLAUDE.md                       # Core governance document
```

### Tier 2: Core Agents (always copied)

```
.claude/agents/backend-developer.md
.claude/agents/code-reviewer.md
.claude/agents/database-architect.md
.claude/agents/frontend-developer.md
.claude/agents/security-auditor.md
.claude/agents/solution-architect.md
.claude/agents/test-engineer.md
```

### Tier 2: Core Skills (always copied)

```
.claude/skills/external-plugins.md
.claude/skills/implementation-execution.md
```

### Tier 3: Domain Modules (optional, per `-IncludeDomains`)

Auto-discovered by scanning `.claude/agents/` and `.claude/skills/` for files with prefixes not matching any core agent name.

### Excluded (never copied)

```
CLAUDE.project.md               # Project-specific configuration
.claude/settings.local.json     # Local environment overrides
.specify/memory/*               # Project-specific governance
.specify/metrics/*              # Project-specific metrics
.specify/plans/*                # Project-specific plans
.specify/checklists/*           # Project-specific checklists
specs/*                         # Project-specific feature specs
docs/*                          # Project-specific documentation
```

### Placeholder Directories (created empty)

```
.specify/memory/                # For constitution
.specify/metrics/               # For agent metrics
.specify/plans/                 # For implementation plans
specs/                          # For feature specifications
```

## State Transitions

The script has no persistent state. Each invocation follows this flow:

```
Parameters → Validate → Build Manifest → Discover Domains
    → Filter (apply IncludeDomains) → Detect Conflicts
    → Execute (or Preview) → Report → Exit
```

## Relationships

```
FileEntry *--1 Tier Classification
FileEntry *--0..1 DomainModule (domain files only)
CopyOperation 1--1 FileEntry
CopyResult 1--* CopyOperation
CopyResult 1--* DomainModule (available)
```
